scope: CPU-only source and safety audit; no model weights, CUDA context, or GPU execution

findings.current_behavior: Explicit legacy smoke flags are checked before runtime/model/CUDA work; the legacy entrypoint performs one disposable optimizer step and writes its own report after its work path.
findings.gap: It is a one-sample smoke, does not supply parent-owned process-group hard timeout, and cannot meet the frozen 1+4 fixed-sample protocol by itself.
findings.risk: Caller or process shutdown can prevent complete child-side report finalization; it must remain behind independent parent supervision.

findings.current_behavior: Formal trainer validates the three-task split, normalizers, complete HDF5 manifest and SHA identities; OpenVLA base is frozen, q_proj/v_proj LoRA is configured r32/alpha16, and the 42D projector is trained. Runtime labels encode 14 joint_delta_v1 tokens plus STOP.
findings.gap: Formal trainer is a five-epoch loop and must not be used to approximate a five-sample disposable smoke.
findings.risk: Any R46 adapter must not change training flags, schedule, labels, inputs, or source/runtime checks.

findings.current_behavior: Production path reads three ordered camera JPEGs, converts BGR to RGB, applies the frozen image transform and moves processor tensors to selected device; cache is bounded.
findings.gap: Processor tensor shape is not simply camera count; this server's production transform yields [1,18,224,224].
findings.risk: Shape validation must preserve processor semantics while independently validating the three decoded RGB sources.

findings.current_behavior: Fails closed because actual OpenVLA forward/backward/optimizer benchmark is not wired.
findings.risk: Never present the placeholder as measured performance.

findings.current_behavior: Validates the published R47 approval shape, exact source and artifact hashes, GPU UUID/memory/utilization and process exclusivity; launches a fixed child in a new POSIX session; writes fsynced events/final status and sends signals only to verified child PGID.
findings.risk: The supervisor is not validated by an actual GPU run; production deployment still requires a reviewed commit plus separate human approval.

findings.current_behavior: Requires a parent PID/process group and exact approved UUID before heavy imports; revalidates approval, strict R44 CPU contracts, fixed sample plan, model index and three shard SHA; reuses R44 model/label path and R45 production reader for exactly five disposable optimizer steps.
findings.risk: Forward/backward, memory, and throughput behavior remain UNKNOWN_GPU_NOT_RUN.

findings.current_behavior: Selects five deterministic, unique push_T TRAIN episodes from real split/manifest, hashes selected HDF5 files, checks real instruction/state/action/RGB decoding/42D features/action tokens and uses production CPU image preprocessing.
findings.risk: CPU sample validation does not load 7B weights or establish GPU performance.

gate_decision: CPU implementation can proceed; R47 GPU execution requires separate explicit approval. R48 is blocked pending R47 evidence.
